svg.title: Fixed-colour BVB FIFO and pixel-stop contrast
svg.desc: Two configuration-only controls and two separately qualified sole-START trials sample the PX_RD_BVB view. Before START the raw tap is 00080020; every active tap in 32 complete non-atomic bundles is 00080044. The CSM field remains zero, named IDLE in the RDB. FIFO_EMPTY changes from 1 to 0; FIFO_FULL and PIXEL_STOP change from 0 to 1. Opaque DBUF indices remain WR0 and RD16. These are raw sampled fields, not accepted transfer, continuous state, completion or source ownership. All four paired saved25 retirements and eight 180-frame full-byte native controls passed.

g.text: PX_RD_BVB selector 0x0c · two config controls + two separate sole-START trials · default OFF
Same tuple in both config controls and both pre-START bundles
16 complete bundles per trial; repeated in the fresh session
DBUF fields are opaque indices, never followed. No tap field terminates the PX observation loop.
Separate words: BVB_SAMPLE = 00040168; FEED_STATUS = 00000001; remaining sampled words = 0.
4 exact paired saved25 retirements · 8 native controls / 1,440 full-byte frames · EOS and cleanup pass
A repeated field contrast—not accepted transfer, SCL output, completion or a source/sink lease.
Bounds describe host attempts and sampled bundles, not physical transactions or autonomous device activity.
